title: The Book of Love
feel: Slow ballad, about 70 bpm (estimate); sparse quarter-note strum or thumb-and-fingers pluck

alt_voicings.label: Colour
alt_voicings.note: swap in for G, C and D/F♯; resolve Dsus4/F♯ to D/F♯

sections.name: The loop (every section)
sections.note: The same four bars carry the whole song; play it as long as the record does.

why: One loop for the whole song, so all your attention can go on your **first slash chord** (D/F♯) and a walking bass line.
hard_change: **C → D/F♯** with the thumb over the neck for the F♯. Practise it as a bass line: G – (A) – F♯ – G.
theory: I–IV–V6–I in G: the F♯ in the bass is the leading tone pulling back to G.
steps: Changes alone, slowly: C → D/F♯ → G, thumb first, then the fingers.
With the rhythm at 70% (about 50 bpm): quarter-note strums, walking A between G and F♯.
With the record (the original in G — the covers are in other keys).
tips: Peter Gabriel's (capo 1) and Gavin James's (capo 3) covers are in different keys; don't use their charts.
